title: I HAVE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE THIS
body:
This app is lit! Their programs are backed by science and they actually work for me. No matter how many times I am sidetracked, I keep coming back to my "Fabulous path" and keep showing up for myself whenever I can. I have to say that before I started using this, I had to install 3-5 apps for my productivity and mindfulness goals. Now that I am using this, I can easily practice yoga, recite affirmations, focus on a task, or write on my gratitude journal because the app has already integrated a lot of content for a ton of activities or tasks as part of a routine. It easy to download the content right within the app. I am yet to try the coaching feature.

I just wish that there's an option to take a pause from my routines on rare occasions that I have to travel and adhere to strict business schedule. I think, rest is also healthy. I was sad when I came back from a trip but had to start from the top since I have broken my streak and I missed the continuation of the "Fabulous story".

Also, I hope more icons will be added and that there will be more freedom to customize a task, such as personalizing a task that is readily available on the app's task bank or adding my own / a new one and setting its icon, time, question for reflection etc.

title: Build a Shifting Schedule for each Habit
body:
A sincerely greetings to the creator of this app and for everyone who made this possible. Would you mind If I make a suggestion. Well, Each habit were designed and made to finished every single day, its a little bit hasty for instance exercising everyday is not a good idea according to some health research. So, it would be awesome if you build a setting that for each habit has to have an intervals to gradually appear in a certain day. Like for Monday— Studying, and then Tuesday— would be exercising and then the other day— would be for Yoga only. Shifting a schedule for each habit would make fabulous users less intimidated, overwhelmed, less-stress and develop a sense of clarity and an organized-mind. Because the more the task or habit done everyday, the less it is interesting and convenient. For me personally to be more disciplined.

Although this app never disappoint me and it is actually perfect to track one’s habit to continually move up the day, and would not mind to recommend this to everybody. It is full of beautiful and stunning contents that persuade or motivate people to gradually move up the day and starts a foundation of discipline.

title: Experienced “dark UI” on the first day...

I wasn’t expecting the “dark UI” - making users feel guilty when i didn’t want to use a certain feature. I have to click the “Leave me alone” button just because I didn’t want to share an article with a friend. I hope we can do something about this... 

On the other hand I really see potential in this app. I love the graphics and how it is personalized. Will continue to use it and I will update my review.
author: kiyokins

title: No iPad
body: No iPad version. Pretty bad.
author: Ryskim

title: More diverse
body: I’m vegan so the buying fruits is okay but the eggs are so not okay. I hope you diversify your app more and ask if the member is vegan or not and then make it much more compatible. Also before I downloaded this I was already drinking water every morning and eating breakfast so I wanted to skip it and go to a much more advance habit as I’ve already built the small ones. There’s also the issue that I cannot reread the letters after going to another habit. I wish to continue the sphere membership but as of now I will stop. Over all the app is good for beginners only. I hope it would be much better in the future for the people who are already improving but want to do more.
author: labrodite

title: App bugs
body: My Fabulous app on iPhone is all messed up. I lost my Afternoon and Evening Ritual list, I couldn’t add habits, I couldn’t launch a habit, my Golden Triangle was lost. Please fix this. I’m getting frustrated and frustrated each day.
